RungButtonIcon.text: The picture of the rung numbers button: three numbered rows beside a rail, drawn here with the canvas and added once to the shared speed button images (later calls give the same index). Replace it with a drawn icon in the image list when there is one.
RungButtonIcon.returns: the image index in the shared speed button images

TfmLadder.FontKeyPress.text: Type-ahead in the font list: typed letters pick the first font whose name starts with them, until a pause of a second.

TfmLadder.AfterCreate.text: Frame set-up: hides the caption label and fills the font list with the installed fonts, drawn in their own faces.

TfmRungs.FontKeyPress.text: Type-ahead in the font list: typed letters pick the first font whose name starts with them, until a pause of a second.

TfmRungs.AfterCreate.text: Frame set-up: hides the caption label and fills the font list with the installed fonts, drawn in their own faces.

TPageHolder.Geo.text: Answers the options' question about the page with the geometry the current test command set.
TPageHolder.Geo.returns: the page size and border inset

FV.text: Reads token k of the command as a number.

IV.text: Reads token k of the command as an integer.

Fmt.text: Formats a number for the test output (up to 12 significant digits).

Split.text: Splits a command line into tokens.

R.text: Formats a rectangle as 'left top right bottom' for the test output.

CmdLAYOUT.text: Command LAYOUT: prints the grid's area, row height, number column width and row height text, then every column of every page.

CmdAT.text: Command AT: prints the rung number at a point, or none.

CmdNUM.text: Command NUM: prints the number shown for a row of a page and the rectangle of its cell.

CmdMOVE.text: Command MOVE: shifts and rotates the grid every way it can be asked to and prints whether anything changed, and whether it can be resized.

CmdPROPS.text: Command PROPS: lists the grid's properties, sets and reads each through UProps, and tries bad and out-of-range values.

CmdBAD.text: Command BAD: loads a file whose rung grid has out-of-range settings and prints what they were brought to.
